sentences.text: The National Anti-Corruption Commission investigated whether a senior Home Affairs official improperly influenced the recruitment of her sister's fiancé and assisted her sister in another recruitment process.
sentences.support:
into whether a Senior Executive Service staff 
member in the Department of Home Affairs had 
improperly used her position

sentences.text: The Commission found that the official abused her office and misused official information, amounting to serious and systemic corrupt conduct.
sentences.support:
The findings that the official engaged in conduct 
which was an abuse of her office as a public 
official and a misuse of official information

sentences.text: The Commission made no corrupt-conduct finding against the official's sister or her sister's fiancé.
sentences.support:
The Commission did not find that the official’s 
sister or her fiancé engaged in corrupt conduct.

sentences.text: The Commission made three recommendations covering recruitment conflicts of interest, access to interview questions and changes to Home Affairs recruitment policies.
sentences.support:
Reduce the risk of undisclosed conflicts 
of interest in recruitment (whether by 
deliberate intent, error or oversight) by:

notes: The report uses pseudonyms; the summary uses roles only. Existing OPAX findings are not duplicated.
